name: Zebul
bio: Zebul was the official Abimelech appointed to govern the city of Shechem. When Gaal arrived and stirred the people against Abimelech, openly mocking him at a feast, Zebul grew furious on hearing it and secretly sent word to Abimelech, advising him to set an ambush by night and attack the next morning when Gaal came out of the city (Judges 9:28-33). The plan succeeded, Gaal's men were routed, and Zebul then drove Gaal and his brothers out of Shechem for good (Judges 9:40-41). Zebul's loyalty to Abimelech and his shrewd counsel were key to defeating Gaal's challenge.
